probes.label: accessor
probes.why: An accessor target selects the createEffect branch at eventListener.js:24; plain-target primary selects createRenderEffect at :25. Both need their own runtime confirmation.

probes.label: target-tracking
probes.why: Target accessor is computed by the listener effect. Both callbacks read a signal in the case file. Only the misuse attempts an owned-scope write; the correct twin writes in the driven event handler.

probes.label: type-tracking
probes.why: The plain-target branch computes event names synchronously in a render effect; catch the intended misuse write so readiness can settle. Both callbacks read a signal in the case file. Only the misuse attempts an owned-scope write; the correct twin writes in the driven event handler.

probes.label: host-dispatch
probes.why: The native EventTarget dispatch invokes the installed handler without restoring registration ownership; onCleanup in the case-file handler warns, while re-entering the captured component owner is clean.
